translation: Thus reaching spring it changes into warm disease (wenbing); reaching summer it changes into summer disease (shubing). Summer disease is heat at its extreme, heavier than warm disease. Therefore, that hard-working people have many warm-heat diseases in spring and summer is all caused by encountering and braving cold in winter; it is not the qi of the seasonal epidemic (shixing). As for the seasonal epidemic, in spring it should be warm but instead is greatly cold, in summer it should be hot but instead is greatly cold, in autumn it should be cool but instead is greatly hot, and in winter it should be cold but instead is greatly warm. This is having the qi when it is not the season; therefore, in the course of a year, the diseases of the old and young are mostly similar; this is the qi of the seasonal epidemic.
